composition: ONE fixed camera for the whole series: about 35 degrees above the table, slightly from the front, the tile centered and filling about 70% of the square with even margins (at least 14% on every side). It is ONE single small diorama tile that will be placed inside an open lunch box, so it must read as one compact object on its own little round base, not as a landscape. No table, no cloth, no shadow plate: the tile floats on a fully transparent background (PNG alpha). Soft warm daylight from the upper-left, soft short shadow only within the tile. Matte clay / miniature toy texture, rounded simplified shapes, bright but not neon.
forbidden_objects: attribute marks, icons, badges or symbols
table, cloth, background, backdrop or drop shadow outside the tile
background: fully transparent (PNG alpha). If a transparent background is impossible, use a single flat pure white #FFFFFF backdrop with NO gradient and NO shadow outside the tile.

Same matte clay / miniature toy material, same lighting and same warm palette as the school tile and the dish set.
